Specification of Network Management
AUTOSAR AP Release 18-10

PN Info Length = 2
In the above example only Byte 3 and Byte 4 of the NM message contain PN request
information.
Note: every bit of the PN Info Range represents one Partial Network. If the bit is set to
1 the Partial Network is requested. If the bit is set to 0 there is no request for this PN.
The Adaptive Application requesting the partial network, shall encode the information in
the form of Bit fields and use the methods
RequestNetwork
and
ReleaseNetwork
.
[SWS_ANM_00081]
⌈
The Nm shall optionally filter out messages containing PN re-
quest information if they do not contain at least one bit set to 1 that corresponds to a
pnc that is configured for this ECU.
⌋
(RS_Nm_00150)
Note: When activated the Nm
Message Filter Algorithm will filter out any Nm Message not containing at least one
relevant PN beeing requested (its Bit in the PN vector set to 1). Note: (Independent)
Message Filter Mask like in Classic Platform is currently not forseen.
